subject: Diego Ramirez — elevation packet coordination and audit log pull
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Diego Ramirez — elevation packet coordination and audit log pull

Team —

Quick sync on Diego's level-change packet. We want to get a clean packet into the committee by the end of next week; a couple of sensitive items mean we should lock the evidence path before the committee slot is requested. Action items and notes below: 

- Diego: please review the attached draft write-up (diego_writeup_v1.pdf). I left a short manager narrative and two examples of cross-team impact — please add one more client-facing outcome and a short section on mentoring.
- Laura: can you confirm two possible committee windows (I suggested Apr 28 or May 5) and start slot reservation with the review panel?
- Neha: we need an audit log pull (last 18 months) for the projects listed on p.2 of the write-up — there are data-access events we may need to redact before sharing outside People Ops. Also confirm compensation benchmarking (market + internal comp ladder) — I put a placeholder in the draft.
- Marissa: will coordinate the endorsements from Eng and Product; if you can consolidate one-paragraph endorsements from each stakeholder, that will speed the packet.

Attachments: diego_writeup_v1.pdf (draft).

Privacy note: some evidence will require the secure HR bucket upload and a short justification to Legal. Neha, please loop the external vendor only if needed for log extraction.

Goal: committee-ready packet by 2027-04-25 (internal review) so we can request a panel date the week of Apr 26.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Diego Ramirez — elevation packet coordination and audit log pull

Thanks, Michael —

I can hold Apr 28 (afternoon) and May 5 (morning) as tentative committee slots; I'll lock once we have Neha's confirmation on the sensitive material path. A couple of notes: 

- I took a pass on comp comparisons and attached a simple workbook (comp_comparison.xlsx) — please review the ~market comp row I flagged.
- Marissa: when you pull endorsements, can you push them into the shared Drive folder (link below) and name files with the role and approver (e.g., eng-lead_endorsement.pdf)?
- Diego: if you have any client citations that are not NDA-bound, add them to the write-up as bullets — the committee appreciates concrete outcomes.

Drive (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AEXAMPLE-diego-packet

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: hr-audit@payrollsvc.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Diego Ramirez — elevation packet coordination and audit log pull

Folks —

I will pull the audit logs for the listed projects (18-month window) and stage them in the secure HR bucket. The vendor (hr-audit@payrollsvc.com) can assist if we need system-level extracts; I've CC'd them to start the request thread. A few points: 

- Legal signoff: because some events include external collaborator records, Legal needs to sign the evidence justification. I will draft the memo and loop Legal after I see the first set of logs.
- Redaction plan: once logs are in the HR bucket, I'll run a redaction pass to remove PII and mark items that need manager attestation before committee.
- Comp benchmarking: I'm attaching a quick export (sensitive_evidence.zip) containing the internal ladder snapshot and market comps; password-protected — I'll share the password over 1:1.

Tentative timeline: log extraction complete by Tue 2027-04-20 EOD; redaction pass and attestation notes by Wed 2027-04-21. If we need a blackout exemption for wider sharing before Apr 25, please advise and I'll prepare a justification.

Neha Kapoor
Senior People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference

Thanks, all — appreciate the fast turnaround. Two quick items from my side: 

1) On the write-up I removed one client citation that includes a partner's internal metric (NDA) — I flagged it in the doc and left an alternate public-facing metric.
2) If possible, please redact the user IDs from the audit log extracts before they go into the share with endorsements; I can provide attestations for the activity windows if that helps the panel.

I'll push the revised write-up into the Drive folder by EOD today.

Diego Fernandez
Staff Software Engineer
Redwood Inference
